tags.name: AuthService
tags.description: AuthService defines RPC operations for identity and credentials.

get.summary: CompleteGitHubOAuth exchanges an OAuth code + PKCE verifier, links/creates the user, and issues a session.
StartGitHubOAuth generates a PKCE challenge, state, and GitHub authorize URL.
GetJWKS returns the active public signing keys in JSON Web Key Set format.

post.summary: Login authenticates credentials and issues tokens with an active session.
Logout revokes the session associated with the refresh token.
ConfirmPasswordReset consumes a password reset token and updates the user's password.
RequestPasswordReset issues a password reset token and sends it if the account exists.
ChangePassword verifies current_password, updates password, and revokes other sessions.
Refresh rotates the refresh token and issues a fresh access token.
Register creates a new user and password credential.
ResendVerification issues a new email verification token and sends it if the account is unverified.

get.summary: ListSessions returns active sessions for the authenticated user.

delete.summary: RevokeSession revokes a specific session belonging to the authenticated user.

post.summary: VerifyEmail validates a verification token and marks the user's email verified.

get.summary: GetMe retrieves the authenticated user's profile.
ListOrganizations lists all organizations the user belongs to.

post.summary: CreateOrganization creates an organization with the caller as owner.
AcceptInvite accepts an organization invitation token.

get.summary: GetOrganization returns an organization by ID.
ListAuditEvents lists append-only audit events for an organization, gated by `audit:read`.

post.summary: CreateInvite creates an organization invitation token.

delete.summary: RevokeInvite revokes a pending organization invitation.

get.summary: ListMembers lists members of an organization.

post.summary: AddMember adds an existing user by email to an organization.

delete.summary: RemoveMember removes a member from an organization.

patch.summary: UpdateMemberRole updates a member's role in an organization.

get.summary: ListAPITokens lists active API tokens for an organization.

post.summary: CreateAPIToken creates an org-scoped API token (`kr0n_pat_...`).

delete.summary: RevokeAPIToken revokes an organization API token.

get.summary: ListRoles returns all RBAC roles and their granted permissions.
